headline: Advantest Shares Surge Amid Strong Semiconductor Testing Demand
summary: Shares of semiconductor testing equipment manufacturer Advantest surged during Japanese trading hours.
why: Advantest is a dominant supplier of automatic testing systems required for high-end AI semiconductors and advanced memory chips.

impacts.name: Advantest Corporation
impacts.why: Heavy equity market demand drove Advantest shares sharply higher.

why_moved: Strong market buying sent Advantest stock surging in Tokyo amid broader tech and chip equipment trading momentum.
